content: Agentic clinical decision-support architecture consensus (multiple independent sources: MDPI survey, Momentum, Pariveda, Innovaccer): human-in-the-loop is a PERMANENT architectural requirement, not a temporary limitation. High-risk actions (diagnosis, prescribing, queue movement) require explicit clinician approval; lower-risk steps may run with greater autonomy under audit. Recurring components: planning/reasoning + tool use, memory, risk-stratified guardrails (confidence thresholds), secure sandboxing of agent code, and transparent hash-capable audit logs for regulatory accountability. 'Doctor-in-the-Loop' = AI recommends, clinician approves. Least privilege + no egress for patient data.
